strongest_angle: Examining the federal court ruling in Miami where U.S. District Judge Darrin Gayles dismissed Donald Trump's $10 billion defamation lawsuit against The Wall Street Journal, Dow Jones, and Rupert Murdoch with prejudice.

key_facts.fact: U.S. District Judge Darrin Gayles in Miami dismissed Donald Trump's $10 billion defamation lawsuit against The Wall Street Journal and Rupert Murdoch on Saturday, October 31, 2026.
The lawsuit targeted Dow Jones and media mogul Rupert Murdoch over a July 2025 story reporting on a birthday book letter allegedly sent to Jeffrey Epstein.
U.S. District Judge Darrin Gayles ruled that Donald Trump failed to plausibly allege actual malice by the newspaper and other defendants.

quotes.text: Saying the president was “grasping at straws,” a federal judge on Saturday threw out Donald Trump’s $10 billion lawsuit against The Wall Street Journal and media mogul Rupert Murdoch over a story reporting on his ties to Jeffrey Epstein.
quotes.speaker: Dave Collins
